verdict.rationale: No evidence anywhere in the pack of MCP server support—NotebookLM's ecosystem is limited to specific first-party source types (PDFs, docs, websites, YouTube) and output formats (audio, video, slides), with no mention of MCP integration or plugging in external tool servers. This is a fair axis for an AI-native research tool, but the evidence shows only fixed source connectors, not extensible tool use via MCP. Missing for 10: any mention of MCP client/server support, tool-use extensibility, or third-party integration protocol.
